card.name: Nonprofit organization names and leaders
card.fires_on: Words inside or right after the name of a nonprofit, foundation or advocacy group, or in the title of its leader (president and, executive director). Seen in attributions and web addresses.

modes.label: Leader titles
modes.description: Linking word or title word in a nonprofit head's title, such as president and CEO or executive director.
modes.example: said President<< and>> CEO, Eleanor Hinton Hoytt.

modes.label: Nonprofit names and sites
modes.description: Last part of a charity or foundation name or its web address.

modes.label: Comma after a name
modes.description: Comma after a person's name or an organization description, before a nonprofit role.
modes.example: said Dr. Seth Berkley<<,>> CEO of the Global Alliance for Vaccines

card.writes: It pushes toward donation words such as donate, donors and .org, and away from business words such as company and customer.
card.plain: It spots nonprofit groups and their leaders, and nudges the text toward giving and charity instead of business.
